feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 May 2026 5:06pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 29 May 2026 at 4:10pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over Germany, transferring southeast. Large and slow-moving area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 this evening or at first tonight. Continuing mainly South or Southwest 3 or 4 tomorrow morning and afternoon, but occasionally 5 in the west of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain, drizzle and mist patches over western and central parts by tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor over western and central parts at times by tomorrow afternoon.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Increasing generally South or Southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, occasionally 6 in western and central parts of the area, then veering and decreasing West or Southwest 3 or 4 later in night or at first on Sunday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle petering out, but mist with fog patches more widespread for a time, then becoming fair later in night.


##Visibility##

Occasionally moderate or poor, and very poor in fog patches, then becoming generally good later in night.
